inlineSql: Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY B.AC_NAME) AS SrNo,A.KR_AC_CODE As AcCode,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.AC_REF_NAME As AC_REFBY,B.AC_CITY,B.AC_KHATA_NO, Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrGold, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrGold, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrSilver, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrSilver FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.KR_AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.KR_AC_CODE <> '' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? and A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? And B.AC_GR = ' ? ' ? AND B.AC_KHATA_NO = ' ? ' ? U ? AND B.AC_GR NOT IN ( ? ) ? GROUP BY A.KR_AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.AC_REF_NAME,B.AC_CITY,B.AC_KHATA_NO ? HAVING (round(Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End,2)) + ? (round(Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End,2)) + ? (format(Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end,'0.000')) + ? (format(Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end,'0.000')) + ? (format(Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end,'0.00'))+ ? (format(Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end,'0.00')) <> 0 ? ORDER BY B.AC_NAME

Select Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrGold, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrGold, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrSilver, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS ELSE -A.IR_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrSilver FROM (MFG_ISU_REC AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.KR_AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' ?

' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.KR_AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_AREA ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,B.BOOK_NAME
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '

' ? AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND KR_AC_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? HAVING (SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT) <> 0 or SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN IR_WT ELSE -IR_WT END) <> 0)
